summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Inversiones Aspi S.A., a Holcim Ltd. subsidiary, notified it of progress on a subsequent public tender offer (PTO) for its common voting shares, paired with a simultaneous U.S. offer to U.S. resident shareholders and ADS holders — the local-market and U.S. analogues of a tender offer. The offeror filed a November 11, 2026 brief with Peru's SMV remedying observations, submitting a revised prospectus and Muñiz legal opinion. No price, premium or stake disclosed. BBVA is PTO brokerage agent. Watch SMV approval timing and tender acceptance.
